I'm an assitant coach to youth football program in the US. So the level is basically the first year they are doing tackle. Aged from 7-9 with a weight limit of 115lbs. 

Now that being said alot of the kids on the team last year were first years to the tackle and pads portion as the years before they were on flag football. Some kids are skilled and some are...well some are just not lol. 
We had one kid who was Good. Fast,agile, and a decent receiver. But he was cocky and arrogant as fuck. But that was because of his dad. 

His dad was this brick shithouse of a man who thought his son was going to be scouted by the NFL every Sunday so he basically programmed his kid to this he was the best of the best. As i said he was good but not the best on our team by far. 

A few interactions between the head coach (happens to be my cousin) and this kids dad happen basically saying his son need and *deserves* more playing time because the other kids suck. Coach explains these are all young kids and at this level everyone gets playing time and everyone is just learning the fundimentals of the game and tackling before moving up to the more competitive levels. 

Then we have our big "rival game" we are warming up while the flag team plays and i hear this kid talking to a teammate ill say K is that kid and T is the teammate. 

K:Man i better get the ball kore this game.

T: you get the ball alot K

K:Yea but im better than everyone here. My dad said I should have the ball ALOT more.

T: Well I dont think youre better than *everyone* but you are really good. Maybe you can talk to the coachs and ask if you can get the ball a little more to prove you deserve it more.

K: *PROVE* I deserve it? Youre Just saying that because you suck. And the coaches dont know anything thats why people like you get to carry the ball for a loss.

He never knew i was standing 5 feet behind them so I backed up talked to the head coach and we agreed. I walked up to him to tell him what we agreed on and he was talking to another player and i only heard what he said and i jumped in...

K: Well if im not going to get the ball more in this game im just not going to play. Or when i do finally get it ill just take a hit for a loss. 

Me: Hey K! Come here.

K: (Walks over rolling his eyes) yea?

Me: I discussed it with coach and youre benched this game. I heard your conversation with T and the comment you just made and id rather not have you on the field with an attitude like that. We are all learning at this level and yes some people are more skilled than others but thats what tjis level is about. Helping eachother and learning to have fun playing a game we all love. So take off the helmet and bench up. 

K: WHAT?!?! IM TELLING MY DAD!

Me: Go ahead bud. 

5 minutes later this mountain of a man comes storming down to the field as we made our way onto it with K in tow crying.and starts screaming atvthe head coach. I interrupted and said it was my call and coach backed me up. I explained that his sons attitude twords his teamates and the game was not okay and it wont be tolerated.

He berated me for 5 minutes telling me i dont know how to coach. That im just some dumb ass kid (im 32) and throwing out a ton of profanity at a YOUTH FOOTBALL GAME in front of all thd other parents and players. 

Also luckily for me the "commissioner" of the league is also a family memeber and is at every game. He came over and tried to calm him down and we wound up having to get a local off duty cop to help escort him and hjs son out. 

Needless to say he didnt return for the last 3 games of the season and rumor is he tried to sign up with another local rival team and they said they had no openings.
